label: Gmail: Send
description: Sends mail as a Google account through Gmail: to/cc/bcc, text and/or HTML, attachments, and replies threaded onto an original message.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs Send mail. Sending from another address also needs Read mail or Organize mail; replying to a message needs one of those or Read mail headers. Without them the node fails before sending, naming what to tick.

inputs.name: from
inputs.label: From
inputs.description: Send from this address instead of the account's own; it must be one of the account's Send mail as addresses set up in Gmail, and anything else fails naming the allowed ones. An address other than the account's own needs Read mail or Organize mail on the connection, to read that list.

inputs.name: html
inputs.label: HTML body
inputs.description: Text and/or HTML; both together send a proper alternative pair.

inputs.name: replyTo
inputs.label: Reply to message id
inputs.description: Gmail message id to reply to in its thread (as a Gmail trigger or Get emits). Needs Read mail, Organize mail or Read mail headers on the connection, to read the original's headers.
